prompt.text: [zemory] Rule_Keys_90_AppFamilyContract: an app of a family uses the family's ONE database (kept by the app-data repo; no database of its own, never DDL), the system-manager's ONE sign-in (the app reads that session and checks its own role; no sign-in page or session cookie of its own), its ONE admin screen for roles, and logs the six event groups with the app-data repo's codes. Roles sit on ONE fixed frame of four levels (1 viewer · 2 operator · 3 manager · 4 admin), each app takes the levels it needs; a person grants only a level below their own; a job title is an HR attribute, never a role. The system-manager holds only the gateway, sign-in, admin screen and links; each app serves its own pages and API.
